requirements.text: Implement colour-coding for different modules in the personalised timetable management feature.
Allow students to hide cancelled classes in their timetables.
Provide an option for students to add personal study blocks in their timetables.
Integrate the personalised timetable management feature to export or sync with external calendars like Google Calendar or Outlook.
Enable viewing of the timetable in different formats, such as weekly and monthly views.
Include a quick access widget for upcoming classes or deadlines on the dashboard.
Provide links to relevant resources or module information directly from the timetable.
Send instant notifications when new grades are posted, ideally within minutes of release.
Implement customizable reminders for assignment deadlines, allowing students to choose how far in advance they want to be notified.
Offer flexibility in notification channels, including options for email, SMS, or in-app notifications.
Allow students to set preferences for the frequency of reminders for grades and assignments.
Ensure notifications are clear and actionable, ideally including direct links to view grades or feedback.
Guarantee anonymity for students submitting feedback to encourage honest responses.
Create a straightforward survey format for feedback available after the teaching period, covering key areas like content quality, delivery, and resources.
Make feedback available to module coordinators only after grades are submitted to prevent bias.
Provide aggregated results for module coordinators to identify trends and areas for improvement.
Include a reporting feature for academic administrators to analyze feedback trends across departments and semesters.
Ensure the feedback system is user-friendly, making it easy for students to access and complete the feedback form quickly.
All enhancements must comply with GDPR.
Ensure smooth integration of new features with the existing portal without disrupting current functionalities.
Consider potential budget constraints and technical limitations during implementation.
